name: Misr Life Insurance Company S.A.E.
source: MUTXRI CRON 18 Nov 2026: Misr Life Insurance Company S.A.E., Intention to Float announcement dated 17 November 2026, Financial Highlights table (page 7 of the document), prepared under EAS 50 (IFRS 17-aligned). Footnote 24 states the year ended 31 December 2025 figures are based on the company's audited financial statements. Figures printed in EGP million and stored here as absolute EGP.
source_note: Two lines only, because the issuer's highlights table publishes insurance contract revenues and net profit without a cost of sales, operating expense or tax breakdown. Revenue is the printed Insurance Contract Revenues of 4,561 million EGP (this line excludes the investment return, which the issuer reports separately as net insurance, reinsurance and investment results of 5,324 million). Net profit of 5,756 million EGP is higher than that revenue line because an insurer's top line here is premium revenue only, not total income. Gross written premiums were 8,944 million EGP. H1 2026 comparatives in the same table are interim and were deliberately not written into an annual column.
